Variants.Content: The silver mines of Castulo along the Guadalquivir basin formed the financial backbone of the Barcid campaigns. Consolidated through Hannibal's diplomatic marriage to the Iberian princess Himilce of Castulo, thousands of enslaved miners extracted hundreds of pounds of high-grade bullion daily, enabling Hannibal to maintain reliable payroll for tens of thousands of mercenaries across decades of war.
